svg.aria-label: Delete Button anatomy: reserved width, deliberate confirmation, hidden sizing grid, focus corner, size family and exploded layers
svg.text: Lift schematic · layers are DOM roles, not z-index
Both states occupy one grid cell; C is the largest.
Morph is the sole Button child: equal side padding.
First press arms; presses before M1 are discarded.
Escape, blur or M2 timeout requests disarming.
Current sizing animates width; widest is stable.
No pending / success layer or async waiting.
XS / SM extend hit height; MD / LG do not.
Grayscale maps slots, not destructive colors.
Shadow light: (Y, BL, SP) in px
ESCAPE / BLUR CAN DISARM AT ANY POINT · TIME AXIS SCHEMATIC
REDUCED MOTION: JS DURATION 0 · CSS DURATION TOKENS 1ms
